correctness.rationale: Euclid uniqueness gives bijections to coprime odd-odd quartic pairs and coprime pairs with an odd second coordinate. Explicit odd-divisor Moebius sums yield 2/pi^2 and 4/pi^2 local densities, and the quarter L4 disk beta integral yields area Gamma(5/4)^2/Gamma(3/2). Both transformed regions have area G/sqrt(2), so constants are sqrt(2)G/pi^2 and 2sqrt(2)G/pi^2; finite boundary length yields O(X^(1/4)log(2X)). Fermat fourth-power descent prevents double counting. Standalone exact enumeration matches independent Euclid triangles for all six bounds through 10^7; finite checks corroborate but do not prove infinity.
